title: 2 BOXES OF EUROPEAN CRYSTAL CH...
reason: Large mixed lot of old cut glass chandelier prisms with good sparkle and pink drops, enough pieces to add up to real money if crystal; quantity and crystal content unverified.
findings: Far more than the two boxes in the title: the photos show a big spread of loose old chandelier parts plus several containers (two plastic boxes, a white tub, a lidded round tub and a bag) holding more that cannot be seen. Visible: roughly 60 long rectangular icicle prisms (up to about 12 to 15 cm) with strong rainbow dispersion, 50 or more pear and almond pendeloques, many octagon and button beads still joined with old brass wire hooks, about 10 scalloped or serrated edge plaques, around 25 clear teardrop or pencil spears, 6 or 7 pink glass drops (Bohemian style), one red glass drop and a frosted fluted glass bowl shade with chain. The strong dispersion suggests lead crystal or good quality cut glass, but no maker's marks or labels are visible, so 'European crystal' is unverified. Counts are my visual estimates.
condition: Some prisms look cloudy or scuffed and a few beads are discoloured. Chips or missing pieces cannot be judged on the loose pieces and the contents of the boxes are not visible. Brass hooks are tarnished.
rescore_note: Several hundred loose cut prisms (long icicles, pendeloques, plaques, pink drops) with good sparkle, plus more in the tubs and boxes; no marks so crystal quality is unverified, but restorers buy this kind of bulk lot.
